name: context-figure
description: On every prompt the person sends, one line for the model: the wall clock and how full the context window is. The person never sees it.

warnAt.title: Warn at (percent of the window)
warnAt.description: Percent of the context window at or past which the warning rides on the line. 0 turns the warning off.

warning.title: The warning's wording
warning.description: What the model is told at or past the threshold; {warnAt} stands for the number. Empty turns the warning off.
warning.default: PAST {warnAt}% of the window: finish or hand the work over soon; a long context degrades without the model noticing it

compactionNotice.title: The notice after a compaction
compactionNotice.description: What the model is told on the first prompt after a compaction. Empty turns the notice off.
compactionNotice.default: a compaction just ran: everything before this prompt is a summary; re-read any file the work depends on before relying on what the summary says of it
